title: Interior $C^{2}$ estimate for semi-convex solutions to a class of Hessian quotient equations in arbitrary dimensions
summary: In this paper, we study the interior $C^{2}$ estimates for Hessian quotient equations $\frac{σ_{3}(D^{2}u)}{σ_{l}(D^{2}u)}=1$ for $l=1, 2$, in arbitrary dimensions, under the natural ellipticity and semi-convexity conditions. We further derive analogous results for the corresponding sum Hessian equations. In addition, we establish several rigidity results.
